frequency_question: How often do central industrial ministries fully design, fund, and officially notify major targeted commercial vehicle subsidization schemes within a 12-month policy window?
membership_rule: Includes central government announcements of dedicated capital incentive schemes for commercial automotive sectors (e.g., FAME iterations, PLI schemes for auto/auto components). Excludes minor grant adjustments or general budgetary speeches lacking specific scheme guidelines.

cases.name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Automobile and Auto Component Industry

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 major national schemes identified and tracked within the ministry's direct domain.
